items.q: There was also another great trumpet -- there were so many great trumpet players during that era. There was Charlie Shaver. I think one of the all time great trumpet players.

ctx.x: A new style. Well, before then it was Louie Armstrong, but Roy came along with a tremendous technique and strong lip, you know. He could play high, higher than anyone else, you know. And he was just -- he was an innovator. After Roy came Dizzy. Dizzy went in another direction. There was also another great trumpet -- there were so many great trumpet players during that era. There was Charlie Shaver. I think one of the all time great trumpet players.

always loved his playing, and I on -- when I appear I always -- if I'm going to do a concert I always include one tune, "My Man." I love that tune and everybody identified it with Billie Holiday. I identify it with Charlie Shavers, When I play that tune -- that's why I play it. I heard him play it and he played it so beautifully I said I'm going to do that tune.
